scope: Complete inheritance reset and history lifecycle for mobile filter.effect, transform.rotate, transform.scale, and animation.transition after their existing Canvas/Save/reload/Publish coverage.
coverage: Each mobile Inspector inheritance reset dispatches responsive.set and resolves to the tablet cascade.
Published mobile CSS remains unchanged during local reset edits.
Undo restores all four mobile overrides; Redo restores the inherited tablet cascade.
Draft Save removes the mobile overrides; Editor reload reads inherited values while published CSS stays unchanged.
Explicit Publish applies the tablet cascade to mobile; desktop public CSS remains independent.
Computed transition shorthand is asserted using browser-normalized duration values.
